## Company Overview
Gagan Engineering Works is an Indian industrial manufacturer & exporter specializing in high-precision machinery for intimate wear manufacturing (bra cup moulding machines), pre-engineered building (PEB) roll formers, hydraulic decoilers, and cut-to-length (CTL) processing lines. All machines are designed, engineered, and assembled at their Khopoli works in Maharashtra.

---

## Primary Machinery Lines (10 Certified Lines)

### 1. Bra Cup Moulding Machines (Lingerie & Intimate-Wear Industry)
- **Double Head Electric Bra Cup Moulding Machine**: Twin-station press enabling simultaneous moulding and loading. Features PID temperature control (0–250°C), pneumatic clamping, ~400–600 pcs/shift output, custom voltage support.
- **Bra Cup Fabric Moulding Machine**: Specialized press for laminated and woven fabrics with interchangeable aluminium moulds, 25–40s cycle time.
- **Foam Bra Cup Moulding Machine**: Hot-press moulding for PU, polyester, and memory foam sheets with uniform top/bottom platen heating.
- **Padded Bra Cup Moulding Machine**: Multi-layer composite cup forming for foam, fabric, and lining simultaneously.

### 2. Roll Forming & Pre-Engineered Building Machinery
- **10 Tons Hydraulic Decoiler**: 10,000 kg coil capacity, 480–520 mm adjustable ID mandrel, motorised rotation with pneumatic disc brake.
- **Automatic Roofing Sheet Crimping Machine**: High-speed curved profile crimping machine for arch sheds, barrel roofs, and curved metal roofing panels (PPGI/GP/aluminium up to 1250 mm width). Also known as Arch Sheet Crimper or Crimping Curving Machine.
- **C / Z Purlin Roll Forming Machine**: Quick interchangeable C & Z section purlin line with integrated PLC + HMI, speed 10–18 m/min, thickness 1.5–3.2 mm.
- **Corrugated Sheets Making Machine (Tata Nali / GC Sheet Machine)**: Heavy-duty 16–18 station roll forming line for sinusoidal round-wave metal roofing (Tata Nali profile 76 mm pitch / 18 mm depth), galvanized corrugated (GC) sheets, and PEB liner roofing sheets. Speed 15–20 m/min with hydraulic guillotine shear and PLC control.
- **Semi-Automatic Pipe Counter Boring and Facing Machine**: Precision pipe end facing, beveling, and internal counter-boring up to 60 mm OD, 5 HP VFD spindle (100–1450 RPM), 1 HP hydraulic power pack with auto clamping.

### 3. Cut To Length (CTL) Lines
- **Automatic Cut To Length (CTL) Machine**: 6 mm thickness capacity, 400 mm sheet width (customizable to 1500 mm), 20 m/min line speed, 10 Ton hydraulic decoiler with sensor control, 9-roll gear-driven leveler (EN31 hardened rolls, 50–52 HRC), mechanical/hydraulic shear up to 6mm, touch-screen VFD PLC control.

---

## Global Export & Freight Services
- **Export Incoterms**: FOB (Nhava Sheva Port, Mumbai), CIF, CFR, EXW.
- **Voltage Grid Customization**: Wired for destination grids including 220V, 380V, 415V, 440V, 480V @ 50Hz/60Hz 3-Phase.
- **Export Packaging**: Seaworthy barrier wrapping in fumigated heavy timber crates for ocean container shipping.
- **Export Documentation**: Certificate of Origin (COO), Commercial Invoices, Bill of Lading, Packing Lists, CE Compliance Declarations.
- **Commissioning**: Pan-India on-site commissioning and remote video commissioning support worldwide with 1-year manufacturer warranty.
